description: Members and shareholders of a Czech company from the official public register open data (ISVR, Ministry of Justice, daily snapshot): for an s.r.o., v.o.s. or k.s. every member with contribution, share (percentage or fraction as published) and paid-up rate; for an a.s. or SE the sole shareholder only (coverage says which); joint shares, released shares and share pledges counted; share capital. Legal persons are NAMED with their IČO (or foreign id and country); natural persons are COUNTED per role, never named (GDPR, rule R1), and an answer with natural persons only is still served and billed. A legal person's name covered by an objection (GDPR art. 21) is served as null and counted in ecartes.opposition; a company whose own name is covered returns the same 404 as an unknown IČO (not billed). Forms whose members the register does not publish, sole traders and undecided forms are refused 404 (not billed). Paid via x402 ($0.02 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

ico.description: 8-digit Czech IČO of a LEGAL PERSON (leading zeros included), e.g. 27232433

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.
